page.overview:
Who is Arcalux?

Arcalux, known as the "Prince of Fury," is a Daemon Prince of Chaos Undivided who has a special connection with Chaos Furies, the lowest form of Daemon in the Realm of Chaos.

No one truly knows for sure what Arcalux's mortal origins were. Some say he was a stranger from the east, imprisoned by the Dawi Zharr. During his enslavement to the Chaos Dwarfs, he brokered a pact with the Chaos Gods and was freed by a flock of Chaos Furies, last seen being carried off into the Chaos Wastes. On his return to the battlefields of the mortal world he was changed. Though the Dark Gods had not yet seen fit to claim his soul, the Chaos Furies still flocked to him.
